course_summary:
ISEN 691 | Research | Spring 2026
Instructor: Thomas Ferris | tferris@tamu.edu
Meets: coordinated meetings each week in the HF&CS lab, larger project meetings
Grading: Midterm deliverable [30%], Final deliverable [50%], Weekly meeting attendance and updates [20%] — A: 90-100%, B: 80-89%, C: 70-79%, D: 60-69%, F: <60%
Topics: HF&CS lab, experimental protocol design, IRB approval, human-subjects study, human subjects data collection, human perception mechanisms, human performance effects, statistical testing, statistical analyses, journal article drafting, Introduction material, Methods material, Results material, Discussion material, peer-reviewed journal outlets, peer-reviewed publication, research project, weekly check-in meetings, interdisciplinary collaborators, literature review, results compilation, results analysis, technical report writing, industrial engineering field, data analysis, final research report, procedure development, technical results communication, lab presentations, research submission, recruitment, testing, analysis, Midterm results presentation, final report refinement, final report revision, summer data collection
